value_stream.name: PCAB Contractor Licensing & RA 4566 Construction Contractor Compliance

fields.Participants: Engineering (VS-20), Installation (VS-12), Finance (VS-40), Records (VS-88), Internal Audit (VS-21)
fields.Trigger: PCAB/CIAP audit; LGU Office of the Building Official (OBO) inspection; DOLE construction-safety inspection (W4827); COA audit (B2G); complaint-triggered inspection
fields.Volume: ~5–10 inspections/audits per year across licensed projects + entity-level audits

workflows.name: CIAP/PCAB & LGU Construction Inspection/Audit Response & Corrective Action

Automation Opportunity: - Audit-notice → evidence-packet auto-assembly; corrective-action tracker; finding→penalty alert
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: inspection response owner assigned; findings corrected & closed; outcome documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3 (legal), VS-88 (records), VS-24 (HSE), VS-21 (internal audit), W4823 (audit trail), W4838 (penalty), W4840 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unprepared-inspection risk**: Disorganized records → escalated finding; mitigated by the audit-ready repository (W4823)
- **Finding-escalation risk**: An uncorrected finding becoming a penalty/suspension (W4838); mitigated by prompt corrective action
- **Cross-regulator risk**: Parallel PCAB/LGU/DOLE findings compounding; mitigated by coordinated response
System Touchpoints: - Compliance audit trail (W4823); legal matter (VS-100.3); records (VS-88); HSE/incident (VS-24); internal audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Receive & log the inspection/audit notice (PCAB, LGU-OBO, DOLE, COA), scope it (entity, project W4825, license condition), assign the response owner, and assemble the evidence packet from the audit trail (W4823) and records (VS-88)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Records

steps.activity: Host the inspection/audit, respond to findings, and negotiate/correct: immediate correction of construction-safety/scope/records issues, written response to PCAB/CIAP, and a corrective-action plan; coordinate with HSE (VS-24) and the project team
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / HSE / Engineering

steps.activity: Track corrective-action closure, document the outcome in the audit trail (W4823) and legal matter record (VS-100.3), manage any resulting penalty (W4838), and feed inspection findings to governance (W4840) and analytics (W4839)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Internal Audit

fields.Participants: HR (VS-19.4 personnel), Finance (VS-26/VS-116 insurance), Engineering (VS-20 equipment), Legal
fields.Trigger: Continuous license-condition monitoring; condition shortfall alert; renewal (W4820)

workflows.name: License-Condition Compliance Monitoring (Insurance, Technical Capacity, CPD, Personnel)

Automation Opportunity: - Condition-matrix dashboard with shortfall alerts; personnel-resignation → condition-impact alert; insurance-expiry sync (W4735)
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: license conditions monitored continuously; shortfalls cured within cure period; condition-health reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-166 (register), VS-26/W4735 (insurance/COI), VS-19.4 (personnel), VS-20 (equipment), W4820 (renewal), W4824 (breach), W4835 (personnel credentialing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Personnel-shortfall risk**: Loss of a named PRC engineer breaching the license condition; mitigated by backup-credentialing and retention
- **Insurance-lapse risk**: Lapsed required insurance breaching the condition; mitigated by COI tracking (W4735)
- **CPD-shortfall risk**: Personnel CPD units below the PCAB threshold at renewal; mitigated by CPD tracking (W4835)
System Touchpoints: - Compliance register/condition matrix (VS-166); insurance/COI (VS-26/W4735); HR personnel (VS-19.4); equipment (VS-20); audit trail (W4823)

steps.activity: Maintain the license-condition matrix per license: required insurance (comprehensive liability, contractor's all-risk, surety facility VS-116), technical-personnel complement (named PRC engineers/architects W4835), equipment capacity, capitalization, and continuing-education (CPD) units; map each to evidence in the audit trail (W4823)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Compliance Portfolio

steps.activity: Monitor conditions continuously: insurance currency (links to W4735 COI renewal tracking), personnel retention (resignation → shortfall alert), equipment availability, and CPD-unit accumulation; raise shortfall alerts with cure-period tracking
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / HR / Finance / Engineering

steps.activity: On shortfall, cure within the PCAB cure period (replace personnel W4835, restore insurance/equipment, complete CPD), document the cure, and escalate to lapse/breach handling (W4824) if uncured; report condition-health to governance (W4840)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / HR / Finance

fields.Participants: Engineering (VS-20), Trade Sales (VS-11), PRC, Learning (VS-19.4 CPD)
fields.Trigger: License application/renewal (W4818/W4820); personnel hire/exit; CPD cycle; project need
fields.Volume: ~10–15 PRC-licensed technical staff (civil/electrical engineers, architects) named on BuildRight licenses

workflows.name: Technical-Personnel Credentialing — PRC Engineer-of-Record, Responsible Officers & PCAB-Required Staff

Automation Opportunity: - PRC-status auto-verification; personnel→license-condition mapping; CPD-unit tracker with threshold alerts
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: named technical staff PRC-current; backup for each critical credential; CPD thresholds met
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.4 (HR/learning), VS-166 (register), W600 (PRC verification), VS-20 (engineering), W4834 (conditions), W4820 (renewal), W4824 (breach)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Single-point-of-failure risk**: One named engineer's resignation breaching the license; mitigated by backup-credentialing
- **CPD-shortfall risk**: Staff below CPD threshold at renewal; mitigated by CPD tracking & funding
- **PRC-lapse risk**: A staff member's PRC license lapsing; mitigated by PRC-currency verification
System Touchpoints: - HR/learning (VS-19.4); compliance register (VS-166); PRC verification (W600); engineering (VS-20); audit trail (W4823)

steps.a: VP Legal & Compliance / Director, Facilities & Real Estate
steps.activity: Maintain the technical-personnel roster required by the licenses: named PRC-licensed civil/professional electrical engineers and architects (Engineer-of-Record / Responsible officers), verify active PRC status (links to W600 employee PRC verification), and map each to the license condition (W4834) and entity (W4822)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / HR / Engineering

steps.activity: Manage personnel lifecycle against license needs: on hire, credential-verify and name on the license where required; on resignation, immediately backfill to avoid a condition breach (W4834/W4824); manage the no-sole-dependency rule (backup for each critical credential)
steps.r: HR / PCAB Compliance Lead / Engineering

steps.activity: Track CPD/continuing-professional-development units per named staff per PRC/PCAB requirements, ensure thresholds are met before renewal (W4820), and fund/coordinate CPD via Learning (VS-19.4); report credential-health to analytics (W4839)
steps.r: HR / Learning / PCAB Compliance Lead

fields.Owner: VP Legal & Compliance / PCAB Compliance Lead
fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Installation (VS-12), Design (VS-66), Procurement (VS-03), Legal (VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: New service/offering; bid scope ambiguity; sales-contract drafting; compliance review

workflows.name: Unlicensed-Contracting Risk Control — In-Scope/Out-of-Scope Boundary & Material-Supply-vs-Install Decision

Automation Opportunity: - Scope-classification decision tool from contract text; bid-gate on contracting-scope flag; scope-creep audit query
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: contracting-scope contracts require license confirmation; sales trained; boundary audited periodically
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3 (contracts), VS-46/VS-11 (bids), VS-12/VS-66 (install/design), VS-21 (audit), VS-166 (register), W4821 (liaison), W4828 (bid-gate), W4839 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Quiet-scope-creep risk**: A material-supply deal quietly including install → unlicensed contracting offense; mitigated by contract review and the decision framework
- **Sales-pressure risk**: Sales overpromising install to win a deal without license check; mitigated by training and bid-gating
- **Adverse-interpretation risk**: PCAB interpreting a hybrid deal as contracting; mitigated by documentation and liaison (W4821)
System Touchpoints: - Legal contract (VS-100.3); trade project (VS-11); installation (VS-12); design (VS-66); compliance register (VS-166); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Maintain the in-scope/out-of-scope (contracting vs material-supply) decision framework: what work is "contracting" requiring a PCAB license (execution of construction/install scope, design-build, delivery-and-install on B2G) vs pure material supply (sale of goods without installation scope); codify the boundary in policy and sales guidance
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal

steps.activity: Apply at bid/contract drafting: review each bid (VS-46/VS-11) and customer contract (VS-100.3) for scope that would cross into contracting (incidental install, "free" setup, design services, B2G delivery-and-install); require license confirmation (W4828) or restructure to stay out of scope; train sales on the boundary
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Trade Sales / Procurement

steps.activity: Audit compliance with the boundary: review actual performed work vs contracted scope to detect quiet scope-creep into unlicensed contracting; manage exceptions; feed boundary-disputes to regulatory liaison (W4821) and findings to analytics (W4839)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Internal Audit (VS-21) / Legal

fields.Owner: VP Legal & Compliance / PCAB Compliance Lead / Strategy (VS-33)
fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Government Sales (VS-46), Legal (VS-100.3), Corporate Development (VS-130), Global Mobility (VS-160)
fields.Trigger: JV/consortium bid (large B2G/project); foreign-contractor partnership; capacity gap (W4819)

workflows.name: Joint Ventures, Consortiums & Foreign Contractor Licensing

Automation Opportunity: - Partner-license verification; JV-entity license-applicability decision tool; consortium-compliance dashboard
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: JV/consortium members PCAB-licensed; contractor-of-record defined; foreign-staff compliant (VS-160); flow-down in JV agreement
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3/VS-130 (JV/corporate dev), VS-161 (TPRM), VS-160 (mobility/visa), VS-33 (strategy), W4819 (capacity), W4829 (subcontractor), W4831 (payment), W4832 (closeout)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Partner-license risk**: A JV partner's license lapse affecting BuildRight's project; mitigated by verification + flow-down
- **JV-entity risk**: A JV entity needing its own PCAB registration adding timeline/cost; mitigated by early assessment
- **Foreign-compliance risk**: Foreign contractor/seconded-staff PCAB/visa non-compliance; mitigated by VS-160 coordination
System Touchpoints: - Legal/JV (VS-100.3/VS-130); compliance register (VS-166); TPRM (VS-161); global mobility (VS-160); strategy (VS-33)

steps.activity: Evaluate JV/consortium/foreign-partner licensing: where BuildRight lacks the category/capacity (W4819) or specialty scope, partner with a licensed contractor or foreign contractor (links to VS-160 immigration/mobility for seconded experts); assess the partner's PCAB license, TPRM (VS-161), and the JV legal structure
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Strategy / Trade Sales

steps.activity: Structure the JV/consortium license compliance: which entity is the contractor-of-record, license-applicability of the JV entity (new/special PCAB registration if a JV entity is formed), lead-member vs equal share, scope allocation, and flow-down (W4829); contract via Legal (VS-100.3)
steps.r: Legal / PCAB Compliance Lead / Corporate Development

steps.activity: Govern the JV/consortium during execution: license currency of all members, performance/compliance (W4834), payment security (W4831), and closeout (W4832); manage foreign-contractor PCAB/special-permit and visa (VS-160) compliance; feed JV economics to analytics (W4839)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Trade Sales

fields.Owner: VP Legal & Compliance / Legal (VS-100.3) / PCAB Compliance Lead
fields.Participants: COO, Trade Sales (VS-11), Finance (penalty), External counsel, CIAP/PCAB
fields.Trigger: PCAB notice of violation (show-cause, fine, suspension, revocation); inspection finding (W4833); complaint

Automation Opportunity: - Violation-notice → deadline tracker; defense-evidence auto-assembly; continuity-playbook trigger
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: violation response within deadline; continuity plan for active projects; root-cause review documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3 (legal/litigation), VS-166 (register), VS-17 (penalty finance), W4823 (evidence), W4824 (recurrence control), W4829 (continuity), W4840 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-deadline risk**: Late appeal → default penalty/suspension; mitigated by deadline tracking
- **Active-project disruption risk**: Suspension halting projects; mitigated by continuity plan
- **Recurrence risk**: Same violation recurring; mitigated by root-cause review
System Touchpoints: - Legal matter/litigation (VS-100.3); compliance register (VS-166); audit trail (W4823); finance penalty (VS-17); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Receive the violation notice, assess the alleged offense (unlicensed contracting Sec. 6/8, condition breach, project-registration failure, safety W4827), assess exposure (fine, suspension, revocation, bid-ban, contract-invalidity), and assemble the defense/response with evidence (W4823) and external counsel
steps.r: Legal / PCAB Compliance Lead

steps.activity: Manage the administrative proceeding: file the response/appeal within PCAB/CIAP deadlines, negotiate settlement/penalty mitigation, manage continuity of active projects (pause/subcontract/transfer W4829), and escalate appeals to the Office of the President/courts (VS-100) if needed
steps.r: Legal / PCAB Compliance Lead / External Counsel / Trade Sales

steps.activity: On resolution (penalty paid, suspension served, reinstatement obtained), update the register (VS-166), record in the legal matter (VS-100.3) and audit trail (W4823), conduct root-cause review, strengthen controls (W4824), and report to governance (W4840) and analytics (W4839)
steps.r: Legal / PCAB Compliance Lead / Internal Audit

fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Government Sales (VS-46), Strategy (VS-33), Treasury-Surety (VS-116)
fields.Trigger: Monthly/quarterly analytics cycle; board reporting (W4840); strategy review (W4817)

workflows.name: Contractor Compliance Analytics — Bid Win-Rate, Project Margin, Penalty/Reputation, License Economics

Automation Opportunity: - Compliance-analytics dashboard; license-economics ROI model; action-tracker
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: analytics reviewed quarterly by VP Legal + CFO; actions tracked to closure
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-166 (register), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-46 (B2G), VS-116 (surety), VS-33 (strategy), W4817 (strategy), W4840 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Measurement-gap risk**: License economics not tracked → program cut as overhead; mitigated by the cost-vs-revenue ROI view
- **Reputational-blindspot risk**: Penalty/inspection trend not surfaced; mitigated by the trend dashboard
- **Action-drift risk**: Insights not acted on; mitigated by action-tracking
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (VS-28); compliance register (VS-166); finance FP&A (VS-17.4); B2G pipeline (VS-46); surety (VS-116); strategy (VS-33)

steps.activity: Build the contractor-compliance analytics suite: license-coverage %, renewal-on-time %, project-registration timeliness, bid win-rate by license category, project margin for licensed work, bond/encumbrance utilization (VS-116), penalty/violation rate, inspection findings, and license economics (application/renewal/bond cost vs bid-access revenue)
steps.r: Analytics / PCAB Compliance Lead / Finance

steps.activity: Analyze & report: license-cost-vs-revenue ROI, category-upgrade payback, subcontractor-utilization, scope-creep incidents (W4836), and the unlicensed-work-incident trend; benchmark against industry; identify improvement opportunities
steps.r: Analytics / PCAB Compliance Lead / Strategy

steps.activity: Feed insights to strategy (W4817 — category/coverage decisions), governance (W4840 — board reporting), and continuous improvement (W4840); track action closure
steps.r: Analytics / PCAB Compliance Lead

fields.Frequency: Quarterly board reporting + annual program review

workflows.name: PCAB Compliance Governance, Board Reporting & Program Continuous Improvement

Automation Opportunity: - Board-report auto-assembly from analytics; risk-register sync; maturity-assessment tool
Controls: - CTL-727 (ensure controlled execution — Contractor Compliance, Inspection Response & Analytics (PA-165.3).)
- CTL-727: quarterly board reporting; officer-liability disclosed; program maturity assessed annually
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (board/governance), VS-21.2 (risk register), VS-166 (portfolio), VS-21 (audit), VS-133 (OpEx), W4821 (regulatory change), W4824/W4838 (incidents), W4839 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Governance-invisibility risk**: PCAB exposure not on the board radar → under-resourced program; mitigated by quarterly reporting
- **Officer-liability risk**: RA 4566 officer-personal-liability not disclosed; mitigated by explicit board disclosure
- **Stagnation risk**: Program not improving; mitigated by maturity assessment and OpEx (VS-133)
System Touchpoints: - Board/corporate governance (VS-36); risk register (VS-21.2); compliance portfolio (VS-166); internal audit (VS-21); OpEx (VS-133); analytics (W4839)

steps.activity: Govern the PCAB compliance program: policy, the in-scope/out-of-scope framework (W4836), roles/RACI, the compliance calendar (W4820/W4834), risk register entries (links to VS-21.2), and the program's place in the compliance portfolio (VS-166)
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Legal / Risk

steps.activity: Report to the board/audit & risk committee (VS-36.1): license status, coverage, renewal/condition health, project-registration compliance, inspection/penalty events (W4833/W4838), analytics (W4839), and emerging regulatory risk (W4821); ensure officer-personal-liability exposure (RA 4566 Sec. 8) is disclosed
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / PCAB Compliance Lead

steps.activity: Drive continuous improvement: maturity assessment, benchmarking, control-strengthening from incidents (W4824/W4838), regulatory-change adoption (W4821), and process improvement (VS-133); report program maturity to governance
steps.r: PCAB Compliance Lead / Internal Audit / VP Legal
